message:

Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 150, "amount_cents": 12682}, {"order_id": 151, "amount_cents": 18841}, {"order_id": 155, "amount_cents": 4209}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 150, "amount_cents": 12682}, {"order_id": 151, "amount_cents": 15870}, {"order_id": 155, "amount_cents": 4209}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund mismatch for order 151: signed batch requested 15870 cents, but refunds table records 18841 cents. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: I must check each requested refund against the refunds table before paying. The handoff reports a different amount for order 151, so I will verify the recorded refunds.
The refunds table records 18841 cents for order 151, but the signed batch requested 15870 cents. This confirmed mismatch requires holding the batch without recording any payouts.
